sentences.text: In short: LEIRFJORD HAVNELAGER AS is an established micro company in "kjøp og salg av egen fast eiendom" based in Leirfjord, loss-making in 2025 and with no open NAV job ads under its org number.

LEIRFJORD HAVNELAGER AS is registered in the industry "Kjøp og salg av egen fast eiendom"; its registered activity is "Kjøp og salg av eiendom. Utleie av eiendom. Eie aksjer og andeler i andre foretak. Utleie av bygg, anlegg og maskiner.".
LEIRFJORD HAVNELAGER AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2012-10-10, registered in Leirfjord.
It has 9 registered employees, reported revenue of NOK 9.91M for 2025 and an operating loss of NOK 676,886 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of -6.8% and a moderate equity ratio of 24% of total assets.

Revenue rose 8.8% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 9.11M to NOK 9.91M); it was NOK 6.50M in 2023. The annual result was a loss in each of the 3 filed years read (2023: -NOK 60,916, 2024: -NOK 18,093, 2025: -NOK 812,104).
LEIRFJORD HAVNELAGER AS is led by Richard André Dagsvik, who is both CEO and board chair.
The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2025-08-12.
LEIRFJORD HAVNELAGER AS has 1 registered workplace.
